```{r, setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse); library(lme4); library(emmeans)
library(flextable); library(officer); library(readxl); library(here)

# Define unified paths
out_dir <- here::here(params$out_dir)
fig_dir <- here::here(params$fig_dir)
clean_dir <- here::here(params$clean_dir) 
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# EEG data to anchor to SRT dates
eeg_clean <- readxl::read_excel(here::here(params$eeg_path))
srt_anchors <- eeg_clean %>%
  filter(str_detect(Original_filename, "SRT_NIGHT1")) %>%
  mutate(
    raw_date = str_extract(Original_filename, "\\d{8}"),
    raw_time = str_extract(Original_filename, "(?<=_\\d{8}_)\\d{4}"),
    srt_start_date = as.Date(lubridate::dmy_hm(paste(raw_date, raw_time))),
    Real_ID = str_pad(as.character(Real_ID), width = 3, side = "left", pad = "0")
  ) %>%
  select(Real_ID, srt_start_date) %>%
  distinct()

```

# 1. Read sleep diary data
```{r, 1-read-diary-data}

# Use here() to ensure the path starts from the project root
raw_diary_path <- here::here(params$diary_dir, "sleep_diary_raw.csv")

# Verify if the file actually exists before reading
if (!file.exists(raw_diary_path)) {
  stop(paste("File not found at:", raw_diary_path))
}

raw_diary_data <- read.csv(raw_diary_path)


library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Define PANAS to strip this from diary data
panas_to_remove <- c(
  "Interested", "Distressed", "Excited", "Upset", "Strong", "Guilty", 
  "Scared", "Hostile", "Enthusiastic", "Proud", "Irritable", "Alert", 
  "Ashamed", "Inspired", "Nervous", "Determined", "Attentive", "Jittery", 
  "Active", "Afraid", "Sum.positive", "Sum.negative", "Complete"
)

# Robust parser for SOL and WASO strings
parse_to_mins_robust <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x) | x == "" ~ 0,
    str_detect(x, ":") ~ as.numeric(hm(x)) / 60,
    str_detect(x, "hour") ~ as.numeric(str_extract(x, "\\d+")) * 60,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(str_extract(x, "\\d+"))
  )
}

diary_processed <- raw_diary_data %>%
  rename(Id = Record.ID) %>%
  # Remove PANAS and empty X columns
  select(-matches(paste0("^(", paste(panas_to_remove, collapse="|"), ")\\.+"))) %>%
  select(-matches("^X(\\.\\.\\.\\d+)?$")) %>%
  # Pivot to long format: handles variable dots between name and day number
  pivot_longer(
    cols = contains("."), 
    names_to = c(".value", "day"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)\\.+(\\d+)$"
  ) %>%
  rename_with(~str_remove(., "\\.+$")) %>%
  # Flexible renaming using matches to catch "fall.asleep...22" etc.
  rename(
    survey_completed = matches("Survey.Timestamp"),
    Date             = matches("Today.s.date"),
    bed_time         = matches("get.into.bed"),
    try_sleep        = matches("try.to.fall.asleep"),
    SOL_raw          = matches("take.you.to.fall.asleep"),
    n_wakes          = matches("wake.up..not.counting"),
    WASO_raw         = matches("awakenings.last"),
    wake_time        = matches("final.awakening"),
    rise_time        = matches("get.out.of.bed"),
    TST_raw          = matches("long.did.you.sleep"),
    sleep_quality    = matches("quality.of.your.sleep")
  ) %>%
  # Start Cleaning
  filter(!is.na(bed_time) & bed_time != "") %>%
  mutate(
    Id = str_pad(as.character(Id), width = 3, side = "left", pad = "0"),
    day = as.numeric(day),
    Date = as.Date(Date),
    
    bed_time = if_else(Id == "008" & day == 10 & str_detect(bed_time, "07:00"),
                       str_replace(bed_time, "07:00", "19:00"), bed_time),
    
    # Parse Durations
    SOL_mins  = parse_to_mins_robust(SOL_raw),
    WASO_mins = parse_to_mins_robust(WASO_raw),
    TST_hours = case_when(
      str_detect(as.character(TST_raw), ":") ~ as.numeric(hm(TST_raw)) / 3600,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(TST_raw)
    ),
    
    # Parse Timestamps
    bed_datetime  = parse_date_time(bed_time, orders = c("ymd HMS", "ymd HM")),
    rise_datetime = parse_date_time(rise_time, orders = c("ymd HMS", "ymd HM")),
    
    # TIB and SE Calculation
    raw_TIB = as.numeric(difftime(rise_datetime, bed_datetime, units = "hours")),
    TIB_hours = if_else(raw_TIB < 0, raw_TIB + 24, raw_TIB),
    SE = (TST_hours / TIB_hours) * 100
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SE = pmin(pmax(ifelse(is.nan(SE) | is.infinite(SE), NA, SE), 0), 100)
  )

#  remove raw columns
diary_final <- diary_processed %>%
  select(Id, day, Date, SOL_mins, WASO_mins, TST_hours, TIB_hours, SE, everything()) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("SOL_raw", "WASO_raw", "TST_raw", "raw_TIB", "X", "Sleep.efficiency")), 
         -matches("Notes|Note|\\.\\.")) %>%
  filter(day <= 42) %>%
  arrange(Id, day)

head(diary_final)

# save diary final
write_csv(diary_final, file.path(clean_dir, "diary_data_clean.csv"))
```

# 2. Read actigraphy data
```{r, import-and-align-actigraphy}
# 1. Define Paths (Required for standalone run)
path_to_files <- here::here("Data", "raw", "actigraphy")
clean_dir     <- here::here("Data", "processed", "actigraphy")

# 2. Re-create SRT_anchors (The Ground Truth from EEG)
eeg_clean <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("Data/processed/EEG/clean_EEG_data.xlsx"))

srt_anchors <- eeg_clean %>%
  filter(str_detect(Original_filename, "SRT_NIGHT1")) %>%
  mutate(
    raw_date = str_extract(Original_filename, "\\d{8}"),
    raw_time = str_extract(Original_filename, "(?<=_\\d{8}_)\\d{4}"),
    srt_start_date = as.Date(lubridate::dmy_hm(paste(raw_date, raw_time))),
    Real_ID = stringr::str_pad(as.character(Real_ID), width = 3, side = "left", pad = "0")
  ) %>%
  select(Real_ID, srt_start_date) %>%
  distinct()

# 3. Load Actigraphy Files
file_list <- list.files(path = path_to_files, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(file_list) == 0) stop("No .xlsx files found in actigraphy path.")

actigraphy_raw <- map_df(file_list, ~{
  fname <- basename(.x)
  readxl::read_excel(.x, sheet = 1) %>%
    mutate(id = substr(fname, 1, 2), Timepoint = substr(fname, 4, 6))
}) %>% rename(Variable = Day)

# 4. Extract Calendar Dates (Handling Excel numeric dates)
actigraphy_date_ref <- actigraphy_raw %>%
  filter(Variable == "Start day") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = matches("^[0-9]+$"), names_to = "Day", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(
    ActualDate = as.Date(as.numeric(Value), origin = "1899-12-30"),
    id = str_pad(id, width = 3, side = "left", pad = "0"),
    Day = as.integer(Day)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ActualDate)) %>% 
  select(id, Timepoint, Day, ActualDate)

# 5. Align Metrics with Anchors
actigraphy_4weeks <- actigraphy_raw %>%
  filter(!Variable %in% c("Start day", "Day of week", "End day")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = matches("^[0-9]+$"), names_to = "Day", values_to = "Value") %>%
  # Filter out non-numeric placeholders
  filter(!Value %in% c("Min", "Average", "Max", "-", "NA")) %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_pad(id, width = 3, side = "left", pad = "0"),
    Day = as.integer(Day),
    Value = as.numeric(Value)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(actigraphy_date_ref, by = c("id", "Timepoint", "Day")) %>%
  left_join(srt_anchors, by = c("id" = "Real_ID")) %>%
  mutate(
    day_relative_to_srt = as.numeric(ActualDate - srt_start_date),
    Phase = if_else(ActualDate < srt_start_date, "BSL", "SRT"),
    Week = case_when(
      Phase == "BSL" ~ "Baseline",
      day_relative_to_srt >= 0  & day_relative_to_srt <= 6  ~ "Week 1",
      day_relative_to_srt >= 7  & day_relative_to_srt <= 13 ~ "Week 2",
      day_relative_to_srt >= 14 & day_relative_to_srt <= 20 ~ "Week 3",
      day_relative_to_srt >= 21 & day_relative_to_srt <= 27 ~ "Week 4",
      TRUE ~ "Exclude"
    ),
    Week = factor(Week, levels = c("Baseline", "Week 1", "Week 2", "Week 3", "Week 4"))
  ) %>%
  filter(Week != "Exclude", !is.na(Value))

 # save actigraphy data
write_csv(actigraphy_4weeks, file.path(clean_dir, "actigraphy_data.csv"))
library(lubridate)

# --- 1. Target only the Clock-Time Variables ---
sleep_timing_vars <- c("Lights out", "Fell asleep", "Woke up", "Got up")

actigraphy_for_collab <- actigraphy_4weeks %>%
  # Filter to just the timing rows
  filter(Variable %in% sleep_timing_vars) %>%
  mutate(
    # Ensure decimals are treated as doubles
    Value_num = as.double(Value),
    
    # 2. Convert Decimal to Clock Time
    Clock_Time = hms::as_hms(round(Value_num * 86400)),
    
    # 3. Apply Midnight Logic
    # Bedtime variables occurring late (Value > 0.5) happened the night before
    Corrected_Date = case_when(
      Variable %in% c("Lights out", "Fell asleep") & Value_num > 0.5 ~ ActualDate - lubridate::days(1),
      TRUE ~ ActualDate
    ),
    
    # 4. Create the final DateTime
    Full_DateTime = as.POSIXct(paste(Corrected_Date, Clock_Time), tz = "UTC"),
    DateTime_Friendly = format(Full_DateTime, "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M")
  ) %>%
  # 5. Clean up for the collaborator
  select(id, Week, Day, Variable, Full_DateTime) %>%
  arrange(id, Full_DateTime)

# Check the results
print(head(actigraphy_for_collab))

```

# 3. Clean actigraphy & align with EEG
```{r, actigraphy-conversion-and-export}
# 1. Define metric categories
vars_to_mins <- c("Actual sleep time", "Time in bed", "Sleep latency", "Actual wake time")
time_cols    <- c("Lights out", "Fell asleep", "Woke up", "Got up")
target_metrics <- c(vars_to_mins, time_cols, "Sleep efficiency (%)", "Central Phase Measure (min)")

# 2. Reshape and Transform
actigraphy_final_wide <- actigraphy_4weeks %>%
  filter(Variable %in% target_metrics) %>%
  # Handle potential duplicates (mean) to ensure clean pivot
  group_by(id, Week, ActualDate, day_relative_to_srt, Variable) %>%
  summarise(Value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Variable, values_from = Value) %>%
  # 3. Apply maths (1440 for mins, 86400 for hms)
  mutate(
    across(any_of(vars_to_mins), ~ .x * 1440),
    across(any_of(time_cols),    ~ hms::as_hms(.x * 86400))
  ) %>%
  # 4. Standardise column names
  rename(
    TST  = `Actual sleep time`,
    TIB  = `Time in bed`,
    SOL  = `Sleep latency`,
    SE   = `Sleep efficiency (%)`,
    WASO = `Actual wake time`,
    midpoint_sleep = `Central Phase Measure (min)`
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, ActualDate)

# 5. Save
write_csv(actigraphy_final_wide, file.path(clean_dir, "actigraphy_data_clean.csv"))
head(actigraphy_final_wide)
```

# 4. Align with EEG data
```{r, 3-align-eeg}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readxl)

# 1. Read the processed EEG data
eeg_clean <- read_excel(here::here("Data/processed/EEG/clean_EEG_data.xlsx"))

# 2. Extract the SRT Night 1 anchor date for each participant
# This date is the "Ground Truth" for when treatment started
srt_anchors <- eeg_clean %>%
  filter(str_detect(Original_filename, "SRT_NIGHT1")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract date (8 digits) and time (4 digits) from filename
    raw_date = str_extract(Original_filename, "\\d{8}"),
    raw_time = str_extract(Original_filename, "(?<=_\\d{8}_)\\d{4}"),
    
    # Create a full POSIXct timestamp and extract the Date
    srt_start_timestamp = dmy_hm(paste(raw_date, raw_time)),
    srt_start_date = as.Date(srt_start_timestamp),
    
    # Standardize ID to 3 digits (e.g., "006")
    Real_ID = str_pad(as.character(Real_ID), width = 3, side = "left", pad = "0")
  ) %>%
  select(Real_ID, srt_start_date) %>%
  distinct()

# 3. Apply labels and calculate study weeks
# We use the diary_final created in the previous chunk
diary_labeled <- diary_final %>%
  mutate(
    Id = str_pad(as.character(Id), width = 3, side = "left", pad = "0"),
    diary_date_obj = as.Date(Date)
  ) %>%
  # Join with our EEG Anchor
  left_join(srt_anchors, by = c("Id" = "Real_ID")) %>%
  # Define Phase and Relative Days
  mutate(
    Phase = case_when(
      diary_date_obj < srt_start_date  ~ "BSL",
      diary_date_obj >= srt_start_date ~ "SRT",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown" # For participants without an SRT Night 1 EEG
    ),
    day_relative_to_srt = as.numeric(diary_date_obj - srt_start_date)
  )

# 4. Create strict 4-week SRT groups
diary_4weeks <- diary_labeled %>%
  mutate(
    Week = case_when(
      Phase == "BSL" ~ "Baseline",
      # Logic: 7-day windows starting from Day 0 (the anchor night)
      Phase == "SRT" & day_relative_to_srt >= 0 & day_relative_to_srt <= 6  ~ "Week 1",
      Phase == "SRT" & day_relative_to_srt >= 7 & day_relative_to_srt <= 13 ~ "Week 2",
      Phase == "SRT" & day_relative_to_srt >= 14 & day_relative_to_srt <= 20 ~ "Week 3",
      Phase == "SRT" & day_relative_to_srt >= 21 & day_relative_to_srt <= 27 ~ "Week 4",
      TRUE ~ "Exclude" 
    ),
    Week = factor(Week, levels = c("Baseline", "Week 1", "Week 2", "Week 3", "Week 4"))
  ) %>%
  filter(Week != "Exclude")

# 5. Verification of the Study Window
summary_check <- diary_4weeks %>%
  group_by(Week) %>%
  summarise(
    start_day = min(day_relative_to_srt, na.rm = TRUE),
    end_day   = max(day_relative_to_srt, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_entries = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary_check)

```

# 5. Plot sleep diary and actigraphy variables
```{r, 2-plot-diary-data}

# 1. Load Required Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism) # Optional, for academic axis styling
library(patchwork) # In case you want to combine plots later

# 2. Define Publication Palette
sleep_palette <- c(
  "Sleep Diary" = "#31446b", 
  "Actigraphy"  = "#666991", 
  "EEG"         = "#d6bdde"
)

# --- 3. DATA CONSOLIDATION ---

# A. Process Sleep Diary Summary
sd_summary <- diary_4weeks %>%
  mutate(
    TIB = as.numeric(TIB_hours) * 60,
    TST = as.numeric(TST_hours) * 60,
    SOL = as.numeric(SOL_mins),
    WASO = as.numeric(WASO_mins),
    SE = as.numeric(SE)
  ) %>%
  select(Id, Week, TIB, TST, SOL, WASO, SE) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(TIB, TST, SOL, WASO, SE), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(
    Source = "Sleep Diary",
    week_label = dplyr::recode(Week, "Baseline"="BSL", "Week 1"="1", "Week 2"="2", "Week 3"="3", "Week 4"="4")
  )

# B. Process Actigraphy Summary
act_summary <- actigraphy_final_wide %>%
  select(id, Week, TIB, TST, SOL, WASO, SE) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(TIB, TST, SOL, WASO, SE), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(
    Source = "Actigraphy",
    Id = id,
    week_label = dplyr::recode(Week, "Baseline"="BSL", "Week 1"="1", "Week 2"="2", "Week 3"="3", "Week 4"="4")
  )

# C. Process EEG Summary
# C. Process EEG Summary (Fixed for Data Type Error)
eeg_summary <- eeg_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Id = str_pad(as.character(Real_ID), width = 3, side = "left", pad = "0"),
    day_num = as.numeric(day),
    week_label = case_when(
      Timepoint == "BSL" ~ "BSL",
      day_num >= 0  & day_num <= 6  ~ "1",
      day_num >= 7  & day_num <= 13 ~ "2",
      day_num >= 14 & day_num <= 20 ~ "3",
      day_num >= 21 & day_num <= 27 ~ "4",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  # 1. Rename to standardized names
  rename(
    TIB = `TIB (mins)`, TST = `TST (mins)`, 
    WASO = `WASO (mins)`, SE = `Sleep Efficiency (%)`, SOL = `SOL (mins)`
  ) %>%
  # 2. FORCE NUMERIC (The Fix)
  # This converts any text/character columns to numbers safely
  mutate(across(c(TIB, TST, WASO, SE, SOL), ~ as.numeric(as.character(.)))) %>%
  # 3. Pivot and clean
  select(Id, week_label, TIB, TST, SOL, WASO, SE) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(TIB, TST, SOL, WASO, SE), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(Source = "EEG") %>%
  filter(!is.na(week_label), !is.na(value))

# --- 4. COMBINE AND CALCULATE STATS ---

combined_plot_df <- bind_rows(sd_summary, act_summary, eeg_summary) %>%
  mutate(
    week_label = factor(week_label, levels = c("BSL", "1", "2", "3", "4")),
    variable = factor(variable, levels = c("TIB", "TST", "SOL", "WASO", "SE"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(week_label, variable, Source) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n    = n_distinct(Id),
    se   = sd / sqrt(pmax(n, 1)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 5. CREATE THE PLOT ---

plot_continuity <- ggplot(combined_plot_df, aes(x = week_label, y = mean, color = Source, group = Source, shape = Source)) +
  # Geoms
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  
  # Faceting
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1,
             labeller = labeller(variable = c(
               TIB = "TIB (mins)", TST = "TST (mins)",
               SOL = "SOL (mins)", WASO = "WASO (mins)", SE = "SE (%)"
             ))) +
  
  # Aesthetics
  scale_color_manual(values = sleep_palette) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Week", y = "Mean ± SE")

# 6. Save and Display
print(plot_continuity)

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("Figures/combined_analysis", "Sleep_Continuity_Comparison.png"), 
  plot = plot_continuity,
  width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
```

# 6. Linear mixed model for both and table with both in (sleep diary first)
```{r, conduct weekly-lmm, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

get_unified_stats <- function(df, v, is_actig = FALSE) {
  
  # 1. Fully Vectorized Clock Helper
  to_clock_vec <- function(m_vec) {
    if (all(is.na(m_vec))) return(rep(NA_character_, length(m_vec)))
    
    # We use abs() for the math and then re-apply the sign for differences
    hours <- as.integer(abs(m_vec) / 60)
    mins  <- as.integer(round(abs(m_vec) %% 60))
    
    # Handle the sign (important for the 'Diff' column)
    sign_char <- ifelse(!is.na(m_vec) & m_vec < -0.5, "-", "") 
    
    ifelse(is.na(m_vec), 
           NA_character_, 
           sprintf("%s%02d:%02d", sign_char, hours, mins))
  }

  # 2. Universal Data Prep
  df_mod <- df %>%
    rename_with(~"Id", matches("^id$|^Id$")) %>%
    rename_with(~"Week_Orig", matches("^week$|^Week$"))

  if (v %in% colnames(df_mod)) {
    df_mod$Value <- as.numeric(df_mod[[v]])
  } else if ("Variable" %in% colnames(df_mod)) {
    df_mod <- df_mod %>% filter(Variable == v) %>% mutate(Value = as.numeric(Value))
  } else { return(NULL) }

  if (str_detect(v, "hours")) { df_mod$Value <- df_mod$Value * 60 }

  df_mod <- df_mod %>%
    mutate(Week = factor(dplyr::recode(Week_Orig, "Baseline"="BSL", "Week 1"="1", "Week 2"="2", "Week 3"="3", "Week 4"="4"),
                        levels = c("BSL", "1", "2", "3", "4"))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
    group_by(Id, Week) %>%
    summarise(Value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # 3. Descriptive Stats
  desc <- df_mod %>%
    group_by(Week) %>%
    summarise(m = mean(Value), s = sd(Value), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Logic for Mean (SD) column
  if (v == "midpoint_sleep") {
    desc <- desc %>% 
      mutate(mean_sd = paste0(to_clock_vec(m), " (", to_clock_vec(s), ")"))
  } else {
    desc <- desc %>% 
      mutate(mean_sd = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", m, s))
  }

  # 4. Model & Contrasts
  fit <- lme4::lmer(Value ~ Week + (1|Id), data = df_mod, 
                    control = lmerControl(optimizer = "nloptwrap", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e6)))
  em <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ Week)
  ct <- as.data.frame(emmeans::contrast(em, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = 1, infer = TRUE))
  ct$week_num <- stringr::str_extract(ct$contrast, "\\d")

  # 5. Cohen's dx
  wide_df <- df_mod %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Week, values_from = Value)
  d_vals <- map_dbl(ct$week_num, function(w) {
    if(w %in% names(wide_df) && "BSL" %in% names(wide_df)) {
      diffs <- na.omit(wide_df[[w]] - wide_df$BSL)
      if(length(diffs) > 1) mean(diffs) / sd(diffs) else NA_real_
    } else NA_real_
  })

  # 6. Formatting
  bsl_row <- data.frame(
    Week = "Baseline", 
    Mean_SD = desc$mean_sd[desc$Week == "BSL"], 
    Diff = "", CI = "", d = ""
  )
  
  trt_rows <- ct %>%
    mutate(
      Week = paste("Week", week_num),
      Mean_SD = desc$mean_sd[match(week_num, desc$Week)],
      d = sprintf("%.2f", d_vals)
    )
  
  # Specific formatting for Midpoint Diff and CI
  if (v == "midpoint_sleep") {
    trt_rows <- trt_rows %>%
      mutate(
        Diff = to_clock_vec(estimate),
        CI = paste0(to_clock_vec(lower.CL), " to ", to_clock_vec(upper.CL))
      )
  } else {
    trt_rows <- trt_rows %>%
      mutate(
        Diff = sprintf("%.2f", estimate),
        CI = sprintf("%.2f to %.2f", lower.CL, upper.CL)
      )
  }

  return(trt_rows %>% 
           select(Week, Mean_SD, Diff, CI, d) %>%
           bind_rows(bsl_row, .) %>% 
           mutate(Metric = v, Source = ifelse(is_actig, "Actigraphy", "Sleep Diary")))
}
```

# 7. Run LMM on sleep diary and actigraphy data
```{r}
# Define Variables
diary_vars <- c("TIB_hours", "TST_hours", "SOL_mins", "WASO_mins", "SE")
actig_vars <- c("TIB", "TST", "SOL", "WASO", "SE", "midpoint_sleep")

# Execute
diary_stats <- map_df(diary_vars, ~get_unified_stats(diary_4weeks, .x, is_actig = FALSE))
actig_stats <- map_df(actig_vars, ~get_unified_stats(actigraphy_final_wide, .x, is_actig = TRUE))

# Calculate Ns
n_diary <- n_distinct(diary_4weeks$Id)
n_actig <- n_distinct(actigraphy_final_wide$id)

# 1. Prepare the data: Merge and clean labels
table_data <- bind_rows(diary_stats, actig_stats) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(Metric, 
                    "TIB_hours" = "TIB (mins)", "TST_hours" = "TST (mins)",
                    "SOL_mins" = "SOL (mins)", "WASO_mins" = "WASO (mins)", 
                    "TIB" = "TIB (mins)", "TST" = "TST (mins)", "SOL" = "SOL (mins)",
                    "WASO" = "WASO (mins)", "SE" = "SE (%)", "midpoint_sleep" = "Midpoint (HH:MM)"),
    Source = recode(Source, 
                    "Sleep Diary" = paste0("SLEEP DIARY (N = ", n_diary, ")"),
                    "Actigraphy"  = paste0("ACTIGRAPHY (N = ", n_actig, ")"))
  )

# 2. Create the grouped structure
# We group by Source (Section Header) and Metric (Variable Header)
grouped_df <- as_grouped_data(x = table_data, groups = c("Source", "Metric"))


         # 1. Prepare the data
# 1. Prepare the data
# 1. Prepare data with a "First in Source" flag
table_prep <- bind_rows(diary_stats, actig_stats) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = recode(Metric, 
                    "TIB_hours" = "TIB (mins)", "TST_hours" = "TST (mins)",
                    "SOL_mins" = "SOL (mins)", "WASO_mins" = "WASO (mins)", 
                    "TIB" = "TIB (mins)", "TST" = "TST (mins)", "SOL" = "SOL (mins)",
                    "WASO" = "WASO (mins)", "SE" = "SE (%)", "midpoint_sleep" = "Midpoint (HH:MM)"),
    Source = recode(Source, 
                    "Sleep Diary" = paste0("SLEEP DIARY (N = ", n_diary, ")"),
                    "Actigraphy"  = paste0("ACTIGRAPHY (N = ", n_actig, ")"))
  ) %>%
  # Create a grouping structure manually
  as_grouped_data(groups = c("Source", "Metric")) %>%
  # IMPORTANT: Clean up the "Source" column so it only shows on the FIRST line of the section
  mutate(Source = if_else(duplicated(Source) & !is.na(Source), NA_character_, Source))

# 2. Build the Flextable
master_table <- table_prep %>%
  flextable() %>%
  # Standardize header names
  set_header_labels(Week = "Week", Mean_SD = "Mean (SD)", 
                    Diff = "Diff adjusted", CI = "95% CI", d = "d") %>%
  
  # A. Format the MAIN Source Headers (Grey Rows)
  bold(i = ~ !is.na(Source), bold = TRUE) %>%
  bg(i = ~ !is.na(Source), bg = "#E6E6E6") %>%
  
  # B. Format the Metric Headers (Bold/Italic Variables)
  bold(i = ~ is.na(Source) & !is.na(Metric), bold = TRUE) %>%
  italic(i = ~ is.na(Source) & !is.na(Metric)) %>%
  
  # C. Remove the repeated column text and Indent
  # This makes the "Metric" row and "Week" rows look distinct
  compose(i = ~ !is.na(Metric) & is.na(Source), j = 1, 
          value = as_paragraph(as_chunk(Metric))) %>%
  compose(i = ~ is.na(Metric) & is.na(Source), j = 1, 
          value = as_paragraph(as_chunk(Week))) %>%
  padding(i = ~ is.na(Metric) & is.na(Source), j = 1, padding.left = 20) %>%
  
  # D. Style & Alignment
  align(j = 2:5, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  
  # E. Final Cleanup: Hide the helper columns
  colformat_char(j = c("Source", "Metric"), na_str = "")

# Save the Word doc
save_as_docx(master_table, path = file.path(out_dir, "Sleep_Diary_Actigraphy_Results_Table.docx"))
```
